    About Us

    Panel X Home Improvement

    Panel X is a home improvement specialist offering premium WPC, PVC and SPC wall, ceiling and floor finishes. We help homeowners and builders achieve a modern, durable, wood-look finish that's easy to install and built to last.

    From fluted feature walls to outdoor decking, every product in our collection is selected for quality, durability and design. This guide app exists to make installation simple — clear steps, the right accessories, and an estimator so you order exactly what you need.
